recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not change Provenance.agent.role cardinality for FHIR-13016; if Security WG wants the newer FHIR-53882-style wording applied to Provenance, handle that as a separate clarification because FHIR-53882 was AuditEvent-scoped.
issue_request: FHIR-13016 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 Provenance. The original summary asked for Provenance.agent.role to be 1..1, but the Jira discussion and resolution focused on separating how an agent participated from role/authorization concepts, including a coded 0..1 participation concept and companion AuditEvent alignment.
initial_application: No explicit source commit mentioning FHIR-13016 was found in the current git history. The migrated current source already represents the split as Provenance.agent.type and AuditEvent.agent.type for participation, while retaining Provenance.agent.role and AuditEvent.agent.role for repeatable role/authorization concepts. Later source history, including f577d68ceb for FHIR-32453/FHIR-32520 and 24aec834ee for FHIR-32519, refined the same issue family.
additional_context: FHIR-13011, from the same DSTU2 Provenance family, states that Provenance.agent.type indicates participation and Provenance.agent.role is intended for security roles such as RBAC or ABAC roles. Later Published/Applied issues FHIR-28184, FHIR-32453, FHIR-32519, FHIR-32520, and FHIR-53882 clarify the role/type distinction and terminology bindings. source/fhir.ini actively includes Provenance and AuditEvent, so the inspected StructureDefinition XML files are current build inputs.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Provenance source has agent.type 0..1 bound to participation-role-type and agent.role 0..* bound to security-role-type-example; AuditEvent has the parallel shape. Changing Provenance.agent.role to 1..1 or 0..1 now would undo later published decisions that separate participation from structural/security role concepts.
